description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot pipeline using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model, and transport layers with custom function handling and event-driven architecture.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining functions that can be called by the language model.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining tools available to the language model.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns with smart turn strategies.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer using Silero models.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame for initiating LLM run in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the processing pipeline for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Runs and manages the execution of the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a pipeline task with parameters.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context for the language model including messages and tools.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates LLM context with user and assistant parameters.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Creates transport layer based on parameters.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Fetches weather data via a function call.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with given transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and runs it.
